name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair McGregor's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the Scottish Highlands. He started as a junior mechanic, quickly proving his worth with an uncanny ability to diagnose and fix engine issues under pressure. This technical aptitude led him to engineering roles within smaller racing teams before he transitioned into management. Alistair believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. His pragmatic approach, combined with an unwavering loyalty to his team, defines his leadership style. While his innovation score may be lower than some, his ability to optimize existing systems and maintain high morale makes him a highly effective Team Principal.

His experience extends to various racing series, from Formula Ford to GT racing, providing him with a broad understanding of the motorsport landscape. Alistair is known for his calm demeanor and ability to make tough decisions under pressure, a trait honed through years of navigating the unpredictable world of racing. He is particularly adept at managing budgets and resources effectively, ensuring that his team remains competitive even with limited resources. Alistair is looking for a team where he can build a lasting legacy and contribute to long-term success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a man of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting his hands-on background in motorsport.

quirks: Always carries a lucky wrench he found at his first race.
